captions.text: These writings are keys that make it possible to open the minds that millennia of obscurantism have shut inside a hard shell.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The door that confines the human mind is blocked by numerous locks that must all be opened at the same time if one wants to free it toward the infinite.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: If only one key is used, the other bolts will stay locked, and if they are not all kept open at the same time when one opens the next, the first closes again, preventing the opening.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Human society is afraid of what it does not know; it is therefore afraid of what lies behind this door, even if it is happiness through the attainment of truth; it too therefore pushes hard to prevent some from opening this door even a little, and it prefers them to remain in their unhappiness and their ignorance.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: That is one more obstacle on the threshold of the door by which the mind can free itself.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But as Gandhi said: It is not because no one sees the truth that it becomes an error, so if you undertake to open this door, ignore the sarcasm of those who have seen nothing or who, having seen, pretend to see nothing out of fear of what they do not know.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: And if opening the door seems too difficult to you, ask the help of a guide, for the guides have already opened the door of their mind and they know the difficulties of the operation.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: They cannot open your door for you, but they can explain to you the various techniques that make it possible to succeed.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: They are moreover living witnesses of the happiness that the opening of the door brings, and the proof that those who are afraid of what is behind it are in error.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In every case, one must always consider things in relation to four levels, first of all:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: in relation to the infinite; - in relation to the Elohim our fathers, our creators; - then in relation to human society; - finally in relation to the individual.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The most important level is the one in relation to the infinite; it is in relation to this level that all things must be judged, but with one constant: love, therefore taking into account others to whom love must be given, for one must live in harmony with the infinite, therefore with others who are themselves also a part of the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Next, one must take into account the advice given by the Elohim our creators, and act so that human society listens to the advice of those who engendered it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then one must take into account society, which has allowed, allows and will allow human beings to blossom on the path of truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must take it into account but not follow it; one must on the contrary help it to come out of its primitive shell by permanently questioning all its habits and traditions, even if laws support them, laws that seek only to confine minds in the yoke of obscurantism.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, one must take into account the blossoming of the individual, without which the mind does not reach its full potential, without which it is not possible to put oneself in harmony with the infinite and to become a new man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall never impose on a child, who is still only a larva incapable of understanding what is happening to it, the slightest religion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must therefore neither baptize it, nor circumcise it, nor make it undergo any act whatsoever that it would not have accepted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must therefore wait until it is of the age to understand and to choose, and if at that moment a religion attracts it, leave it free to adhere to it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A birth must be a celebration, for the Elohim created us in their image, therefore capable of reproducing ourselves by ourselves, and in creating a living being we preserve the species that we are and we respect the work of our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A birth must be a celebration and an act of love, accomplished in harmony, as much regarding the sounds as the colors or the temperature, so that the being who makes contact with life takes on the habit of harmony.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must, on the other hand, accustom it immediately to respecting the freedom of others, and when it cries at night come to see it discreetly but without it ever realizing that the act of crying brings it a certain well-being because one takes care of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the contrary, one must come to see it and take care of it when it says nothing, and not come to see it when it cries (or do so without it noticing).
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus it will get used to everything going better when it is in harmony with what surrounds it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Help yourself, and Heaven will help you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Parents must indeed understand, from birth, that a child is above all an individual and that no individual must be treated as a child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Even our creators do not treat us as children but as individuals; that is why they do not intervene to help us directly resolve our problems, leaving us, by our own reflection as responsible individuals, to overcome the obstacles we encounter.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The little being, who is still only a larva of a man, must, in its early childhood, be accustomed to respecting the freedom and the tranquillity of others.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Given that it is too small to understand and to reason, corporal punishment must be applied with rigor by the person who raises a child, so that it suffers when it makes others suffer, or when it disturbs them by being disrespectful to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This corporal punishment must be applied only to very small children, then, as the child reasons and understands, disappear progressively and finally disappear totally.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: From the age of seven, corporal punishment must be quite exceptional, and from the age of fourteen it must never again be applied.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall use corporal punishment only to punish in the child a lack of respect for the freedom or the tranquillity of others and of yourself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach your child to blossom, and you shall teach it always to take a step back in relation to what society and its schools want to instill in it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not force it to learn things that will be of no use to it, and you shall let it take the orientation it wishes to take, for do not forget that the most important thing is its blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall always teach it to judge things successively in relation to the infinite, in relation to our creators, in relation to society, and in relation to itself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall impose no religion on your child but you shall teach it without bias the various beliefs that exist throughout the world, at least the most important ones in chronological order: the Jewish religion, the Christian religion and the Muslim religion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you can, you shall try to learn the broad outlines of the Eastern religions in order to be able to explain them to your child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally you shall explain to it the broad outlines of the message given by the Elohim to the last of the prophets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it above all to love the world in which it lives and, through this world, our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it to open itself to the infinite and to try to live in harmony with the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it the marvelous work that the Elohim our creators accomplished, to reflect and to seek always so that human beings may one day be capable of doing again what their creators did: creating elsewhere other humanities, scientifically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it to consider itself a part of the infinite, that is to say much and little.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are dust and you shall become dust again.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it that the harm one does to others, no confession, no absolution can repair it once it is done, and that one must not believe that it suffices to begin, when death is near, to believe in some god or other, or in the Elohim, to have the right to eternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach it that we are judged on what we do throughout our life and that the road that leads to wisdom is long and that a whole life is indeed needed to engage in it sufficiently.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The one who has not followed the right direction throughout his life, it is not because he will suddenly take the right path that he will be able to have the right to scientific resurrection on the planet of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Unless his regret is sincere and he acts with intensity in the right direction to make up for lost time, seeking to be forgiven by those to whom he did harm and trying to put all his means to bring them love and happiness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And that will still not be sufficient for the one who has made others suffer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For if he gets himself forgiven by them and if he gives them love, he will only have managed to erase his errors but he will have done nothing positive; he must therefore undertake new actions, bringing happiness to persons whom he has never harmed, while helping those who spread the truth, the guides.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But a being who regrets only at the moment of his death or a little while before, it is too late for him, he will not be forgiven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is one of the most important things, and one which practically does not exist at present.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall awaken the mind of your child, but you shall also awaken its body, for the awakening of the body goes hand in hand with the awakening of the mind.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All those who seek to put bodies to sleep are also putters-to-sleep of minds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Our creators gave us senses; it is so that we use them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The nose is made for smelling, the eyes for seeing, the ears for hearing, the mouth for tasting and the fingers for touching.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We must develop our senses in order to enjoy better all that surrounds us and that our creators placed there so that we might enjoy it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A sensual being has much more chance of being in harmony with the infinite because he feels it without having to meditate or to reflect.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Meditation and reflection will allow this being to understand this harmony better and to make it radiate around him by teaching it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To be sensual is to let the environment where one finds oneself give one pleasure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Sexual education is very important too, but it teaches only the technical functioning of the organs and their usefulness, whereas sensual education must teach how one can have pleasure through one's organs, seeking only pleasure; without necessarily seeking to use one's organs for the utilitarian purpose that is theirs.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To say nothing to one's children about sex is bad, to explain to them what it is for is better but it is still not sufficient: one must explain to them how they can use it to derive pleasure from it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To explain to them only what it is for is as if one spoke to them of music by telling them that it serves to march in step, or other inanities, or that knowing how to write serves only to make letters of complaint, or that cinema serves only to give courses in audiovisual.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Fortunately, thanks to artists and through an awakening of the senses, one can derive pleasure from listening to, reading or watching works that are made for nothing other than to give pleasure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For sex, it is the same thing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It serves not only to satisfy natural needs or to ensure reproduction, but equally to give pleasure to others and to oneself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have finally come out, thanks to science, of the times when showing one's body was a sin, and when every coupling carried within it its punishment: the conception of a child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now, thanks to contraceptive techniques, sexual union is freely possible without it becoming a definitive engagement or one that could be such.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach this to your child without shame but on the contrary with love, explaining clearly to it that it is made to be happy and to blossom fully, that is to say to enjoy life with all the force of its senses, of all its senses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall never be ashamed of your body or of your nakedness, for nothing displeases our creators more than to see those they created be ashamed of the aspect that was given to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall teach your children to love their body as one must love each part of the creation of the Elohim, for in loving their creation, it is also them whom one loves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each of our organs was created by our fathers the Elohim so that we use it without having the slightest shame but being happy to make work what was made to work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And if the fact of making one of these organs work brings pleasure, it is that our creators wanted us to have pleasure in using it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Every man is a garden that must not remain uncultivated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A life without pleasure is an uncultivated garden.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Pleasure is the fertilizer that makes the mind open.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Asceticism is useless except if it is a passing ordeal destined to train one's mind to dominate one's body.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But once one has succeeded in the ordeal one had set oneself, and which must always be limited in time, one must again enjoy the pleasures of life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Asceticism can be accepted as a setting fallow of the garden that a man is.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is to say a momentary halt in the search for pleasure, allowing one subsequently to appreciate it better.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall accustom your children to having more and more freedom by considering them always and above all as individuals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall respect their tendencies and their tastes as you would wish them to respect your tendencies and your tastes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And tell yourself well always that your child is what it is and that you cannot make of it what you want it to be, just as it cannot make of you what it wants you to be.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Respect it so that it respects you, and respect its tastes so that it respects yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An individual must seek to blossom according to his aspirations and his tastes without preoccupying himself with what others think of it, insofar as he does no harm to others.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you feel like doing something, look first whether it does harm to no one, then do it without occupying yourself with what others think of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you feel like having a sensual or sexual experience with one or several other individuals whatever their sex, insofar as this or these individuals agree, you may act according to your desires.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Everything is permitted on the path of blossoming, of the opening of one's body, therefore of one's mind.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are finally coming out of the primitive times when the woman was considered only as a reproductive organ belonging to society.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The woman can now, thanks to science, blossom freely sensually without having to dread the punishment of pregnancy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The woman is finally really equal to the man since she can really enjoy her body without having to fear bearing alone the undesired consequences of her acts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To make a child is something too important for it to be due only to chance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When you make a child, you shall make it knowing that you are making it and having chosen to make it, in a marvelous act of love maturely decided and sure of really desiring it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For a child can be a success only if it was really desired at the very moment of its conception.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The moment of conception is the most important moment for it is there that the first cell, therefore the plan of the individual, is conceived; this moment must therefore be desired so that this first cell is manufactured in a perfect harmony, the two minds of the parents being conscious and thinking strongly of the being they are in the process of conceiving.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is one of the secrets of the new man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you seek only the blossoming of your body, therefore of your mind, use the means that science places within your reach, namely to begin with: contraception.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Make a child only when you yourself are blossomed, so that the being you conceive is the fruit of the union of two blossomed beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To attain blossoming, use the means that science places at your service to allow you to open your body to pleasure without risks.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Pleasure and procreation are two distinct things that must not be confused.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The first serves the individual, the second the species.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is only when an individual is blossomed that he can create a blossomed being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If by misfortune you have conceived a being without desiring it, use the means that science places at your service: use abortion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For a being who was not desired at the moment of its conception cannot be blossomed because it was not created in harmony.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not listen to those who try to frighten you by speaking to you of the physical and especially moral after-effects that an abortion can leave.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There are none if you have this done by competent persons.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is rather keeping an undesired child that may leave you physical and moral after-effects from which even the child you bring into the world will suffer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To have a child does not necessarily imply being married or even living with a man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Already, numerous women have decided to have a child or children without being married and even without living with a man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The education of a child, who is from its birth an individual, must not necessarily be done by the parents.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It would even often be preferable that this education be done by specialized persons who would contribute much more than certain parents to the blossoming of their children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you feel like having a child without living with a man, act as you wish.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Blossom as you see fit without worrying about what others think.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And if you choose that, do not believe yourself condemned for all that to live definitively alone: receive the men who will please you and who will be so many masculine examples for your child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And you may even decide one day to live with a man; that will not only pose no problem for your child but will contribute to its blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The change of environment is always positive for a child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Society must organize itself to take partially or totally in charge the education of children at the parents' discretion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who want to work must be able to leave their children in the keeping of competent persons, and those who wish that their children receive entirely an education done by competent persons must be able to entrust their children totally to establishments provided for that purpose.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus, if you create a child desiring it but once it is there you have separated from your companion, or that, for a quite other reason, you no longer desire it, you will be able to entrust it to society so that it raises it in the harmony necessary to its blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For a child who grows up in an environment where it is not really and intensely desired cannot blossom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A child is a reciprocal blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If it becomes ever so slightly a hindrance, it realizes it and its blossoming is affected by it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must therefore keep it near oneself only if its presence is felt as a blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Otherwise, one must place it in the establishments that society owes it to set up to make them blossom, without the slightest regret, but on the contrary with a profound joy which must be that of the person who entrusts their child to persons who will be able better than themselves to make this little being blossom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Regular visits can even take place if the child, whose opinion takes precedence, wishes it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The persons in charge of the education must moreover always describe to the children their parents as exceptional beings, since having put the blossoming of their children before the selfish pleasure of raising them for themselves, this by entrusting them to persons more competent than themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall therefore freely choose your companion if you desire one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Marriage, whether it be religious or civil, is useless.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One cannot sign a contract, as to sell oil, to unite living beings who are going to change since they are alive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall therefore refuse marriage which is only a display of the ownership of a being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now a man or a woman cannot be the property of anyone whatsoever.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Any contract can only destroy the harmony existing between two beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When one feels loved one feels free to love; when one has signed a contract one feels a prisoner, obliged to love and one day or another one begins to detest each other.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall live with the person of your choice as long as you feel good with them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When you no longer get along, do not stay together for your union would become a hell.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Every living being evolves and that is well so.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the evolutions are similar, the unions are durable, but if the evolutions are different, the unions are not possible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The being who pleased you no longer pleases you because you have (or they have) changed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must separate while keeping of your union a good memory instead of soiling it with frictions triggering aggressiveness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A child chooses the garment that suits it and, when it has grown, this garment is too small for it; it must leave it to put on another, otherwise it will end up tearing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For unions, it is the same thing, one must leave each other before tearing each other apart.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Above all do not worry for your child; it is better for it to be only with one of its parents in harmony than to be with both in discord or without a perfect harmony.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For do not forget that children are above all individuals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Society must absolutely assure elderly persons a happy life without material worries.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But, if one must respect elderly persons and do everything for their happiness, one must not listen to the old.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An intelligent man gives good counsel whatever his age, but a stupid being, even if he is a hundred years old, does not deserve a second of being listened to; worse, he has no excuse for he had his whole life to try to awaken himself whereas for a young and stupid being all hope is still permitted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But a stupid old man must in any case be able to live comfortably.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a duty for society.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Death must not be the occasion of sad gatherings but on the contrary of a joyful celebration, for it is the moment when the dear being perhaps accedes to the paradise of the eternals in the company of the Elohim our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall therefore ask not to be buried religiously, but you shall make a gift of your body to science or you shall ask that it be made to disappear as discreetly as possible, except the bone of your forehead, more precisely the part situated above the beginning of the nose 33 mm above the middle of the axis joining your two pupils (at least one square centimeter of this bone), which you shall have sent to the Guide of guides so that he preserves it in our earthly embassy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For each man is followed by a computer which notes and will make the assessment of his actions at the end of his life, but the men who take cognizance of the messages that Rael transmits will be recreated from the cells they will have left in our embassy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For them, recreation will take place only if they have sent to the Guide of guides, after their death, the requested part of their body; for from the day they take cognizance of the message the computer system recording the information that will serve for the judgment stays connected, but the system that allows an automatic sampling of a cell at the moment of death is disconnected, for only those who, having taken cognizance of the message, will apply exactly what it requests, will thus be recreated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall have taken care to see at least once in your life the Guide of guides or a guide authorized by him to transmit your cellular plan to the Elohim so that they awaken your mind and help you to remain awakened.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In conformity with what is written in the Book you shall not leave an inheritance to your children apart from the apartment or the family house.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The rest, you shall bequeath it to the Guide of guides and if you fear that your descendants will not respect your last wishes by wanting, through human justice, to recover your goods, you shall make a gift of them while you are alive to the Guide of guides in order to help him have the message of our creators spread on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And you who remain, do not be sad and do not lament after the death of a dear being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Try rather to give love to those you love, while they are alive for, once they are dead, what makes you unhappy is to think that you have perhaps not loved the departed one enough and that, now, it is too late.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If he was good, he has the right to the gardens of the Elohim for eternity, and he knows happiness, and if he was not good he does not deserve to be regretted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In any case, even if he is not among the elect, he does not really disappear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Death is not a very important thing, one must not be afraid of death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is exactly like when one falls asleep, but with a definitive sleep.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And since we are a part of the infinite, the matter of which we are constituted does not disappear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It continues to exist in the soil, or in the plants, or again in the animals, losing obviously all homogeneity and therefore all identity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But this part of the infinite which was organized by our creators according to a very precise plan returns to the infinite while remaining a part of this little ball that is called the Earth, and which is alive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Every being has the right to life, the right to love, and the right to death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each being is master of its life and its death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Death is nothing but suffering is terrible, and everything must be done to suppress it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A being who suffers too much has the right to commit suicide.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If he acted well throughout his life, he will be admitted on the planet of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If a person you love suffers too much and wishes to die without having the strength to commit suicide, help them to suppress themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When, thanks to science, human beings can suppress the sufferings of their fellows, they will be able to ask themselves whether it is good or not to suppress oneself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is indispensable that there be a government that takes the decisions, as in the human body there is a brain that takes them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall do everything possible to put in place a government putting into practice geniocracy which places intelligence in power.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall participate in the creation of a world humanitarian party advocating humanitarianism and geniocracy described in The Book Which Tells The Truth, and you shall support its candidates.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only geniocracy can allow man to enter fully into the golden age.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Total democracy is not good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A body of which all the cells command cannot survive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only intelligent people must be able to take decisions committing humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall therefore refuse to vote, except if a candidate advocating geniocracy and humanitarianism presents himself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Neither universal suffrage nor opinion polls are valid for governing the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To govern is to foresee, and not to follow the reactions of a sheep-like people of whom a very small part is sufficiently awakened to guide humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As there are very few awakened people, if one relies on universal suffrage or on opinion polls, the decisions taken are the choice of the majority, therefore of those who are not awakened and who react according to their immediate satisfaction or their instinctive reactions unconsciously encrusted in their shell of obscurantist acquisitions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only geniocracy is valid, which is a selective democracy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As is said in the first part of this book, only the people whose level of intelligence in the raw state is 50% above the average must be eligible and only those whose level of intelligence in the raw state is 10% above the average can be electors.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Already scientists are in the process of perfecting techniques allowing the measurement of intelligence in the raw state; follow their advice and act so that gifted children, the most precious ore of humanity, receive an education at the height of their genius, for normal education is made for normal children, therefore of average intelligence.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not the number of diplomas obtained that counts, for that calls only upon a faculty of little interest, the memory, which machines can replace.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Intelligence in the raw state is what makes peasants or workers able to be much more intelligent than engineers or professors.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That can be compared to common sense, to creative genius, for the majority of inventions are only a question of common sense.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To govern is to foresee, and all the great problems that now confront humanity prove that the governments did not foresee and that they were therefore not capable of governing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not a problem of persons but a problem of technique of choice of those responsible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the system of choice that is not good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must replace savage democracy with a selective democracy: geniocracy, which places intelligent beings in power.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the least one can do.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Human laws are indispensable and you shall respect them while acting so that those that are unjust or outdated are modified.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Between human laws and those of our creators you shall not hesitate one instant.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For even the human judges will be judged one day by our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The police is indispensable as long as man has not discovered the medical means that allows the suppression of violence and the prevention of criminals, or those who attack the freedoms of others, from acting.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Contrary to soldiers who are keepers of war, the police are themselves keepers of peace and are provisionally indispensable, while waiting for science to have resolved this problem.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall refuse to do your military service by asking to benefit from the status of conscientious objector which allows you to do a service in a branch where one does not bear a weapon, as you have the right if your religious or philosophical convictions forbid you to kill your neighbor, which is the case for those who believe in the Elohim our creators and want to follow the directives of the Guide of guides.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Contrary to what many young people believe, conscientious objectors do not go to prison but do a civil service or in a specialty where one does not bear a weapon, but for a duration double the normal duration of military service.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is better to be for two years in offices than to train for one year in the techniques that allow one to kill one's neighbor.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Military service is to be suppressed urgently in all the countries of the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All career soldiers must be transformed into keepers of world peace, that is to say put at the service of freedom and of Human Rights.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The only valid regime is that of geniocracy applying humanitarianism.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Capitalism is bad for it enslaves man to money and to the profit of some on the backs of others.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Communism is equally bad for it gives more importance to equality than to freedom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There must be equality of men among themselves at the start, at birth, but not afterward.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If all men have the right to have enough to live decently, those who do more than others for their fellows have the right to have more than those who do nothing for the community.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is a provisional rule obviously, while waiting for man to be capable of having all the chores accomplished by robots in order to devote himself solely to his blossoming, after having totally suppressed money.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the meantime, it is shameful that, while men die of hunger, others throw away food so that the prices do not collapse.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Instead of throwing away these foodstuffs, they must distribute them to those who have nothing to eat.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Work must not be considered as something sacred.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Every being has the right to have enough to live even if he does not work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each one must seek to blossom in the branch that attracts him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men, if they organize themselves, will not take long to act so that all the indispensable work is entirely mechanized and automated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They will then be able to blossom freely.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If all men really set about it, it would only take a few years for man to be freed from the obligation to work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It suffices that all the technical and scientific capacities, that all the workers, in a marvelous burst of solidarity for the human liberation from material constraints, set about working flat out, no longer for particular interests but for the whole community and for its well-being, using all the means that are wasted on military budgets or on other inanities of the same type, like the realization of atomic weapons or space flights which would be much better studied and much easier once man is freed from material constraints.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have computers, electronic equipment that can advantageously replace man; put everything to work so that these technical means are really at the service of humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can, in a few years, make a completely different world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have arrived at the golden age.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Put everything to work to create the biological robot that will free you from the lowly chores and will allow you to blossom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Urban development must be considered as it is treated in the first part.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men must build for themselves communal houses, very tall and situated in open country, so that individual houses do not eat up nature.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Never forget that if each man has his country house with a little garden, there is no more countryside.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These communal houses must be cities possessing all that is necessary for men and able to accommodate about fifty thousand inhabitants.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man must respect nature as long as he is not capable of recreating it, as long as he is not capable of becoming himself a creator.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In respecting nature, you respect those who created it, our fathers the Elohim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall never make animals suffer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may kill them to feed yourself on their flesh but without making them suffer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For if death is nothing, suffering is an abomination and you must spare animals suffering as you must spare it to men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not eat too much meat, however; you will be the better for it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may feed yourself on all that the Earth provides you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are not obliged to follow a special diet, you may eat meat, vegetables, fruits, the vegetal and the animal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is stupid to follow a vegetarian diet under the pretext of not wanting to feed oneself on the flesh of other living beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Plants are equally alive and suffer in the same way as you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not make the plants suffer which are alive just like you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not get drunk with alcoholic beverages.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may drink a little wine while eating for it is a product of the Earth, but never get drunk.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may exceptionally drink alcoholic beverages, but in minute quantity and accompanied by solid foods so as never to get drunk.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For a man who gets drunk is no longer capable of putting himself in harmony with the infinite nor of controlling himself and it is something that is lamentable in the eyes of our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not smoke for the human body is not made to ingest smoke.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This has lamentable effects on the organism and prevents a total blossoming and a putting in harmony with the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not use drugs, you shall not drug yourself, for the awakened mind needs nothing to approach the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is an abomination in the eyes of our creators to see men think that man must take drugs to improve himself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man does not need to improve himself for he is perfect, for he is made in the image of his creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To say that man is imperfect is to insult our creators who created us in their image.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man is perfect, but he becomes imperfect by thinking that he is not and by being resigned.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An effort of every instant to maintain oneself in a state of awakening allows one to remain perfect, that is to say such as the Elohim created us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall compel yourself to meditate each day at least once, that is to say to situate yourself in relation to the infinite, in relation to the Elohim, in relation to society and in relation to yourself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall meditate on waking so that your whole being is perfectly conscious of the infinite to be in full possession of its means.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall meditate before each meal so that your whole body eats when you eat, and when you nourish yourself you shall think of what you are doing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your meditation shall not be a dry meditation, but on the contrary a sensual meditation; you shall let yourself be invaded by peace and by harmony until it becomes an enjoyment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your meditation must not be a chore but a pleasure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is better not to meditate than to meditate without desiring it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not impose meditation on your children or on those close to you but explain to them the pleasure that it procures and the well-being that it gives, and, if they feel like meditating then, try to teach them what you know.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall think at least once a day intensely of the Elohim our creators trying to correspond telepathically with them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall thus rediscover the original meaning of prayer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you do not know how to go about it you may take inspiration from the Lord's Prayer whose terms are perfectly suited to communication with our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall make at least once a week an attempt at group telepathic communication with the other persons of your region who believe in the Elohim and if possible a guide.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall do everything possible to go each year to the gathering of all those who believe in the Elohim and in the Messages they gave to the last of the prophets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Here is a model text to say while thinking intensely of the words that compose it, looking toward the sky.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, you are there somewhere near these stars,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, you are there and I know that you observe us,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, you are there and I would so like to meet you,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, you are there and what am I to hope to deserve a contact,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I recognize you as creator and I put myself humbly at your service,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I recognize Rael, your envoy, as my guide and I believe in him and in the messages you gave him,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I will do the maximum to make them known around me for I know that I have not done enough,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I love as my brothers all human beings because they are made in your image,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I seek to bring them happiness by opening their mind to the infinite and by revealing to them what was revealed to me,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I seek to suppress their sufferings by putting all my being at the service of the humanity of which I am a part,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I try to use to the maximum the mind you gave me to bring humanity out of obscurity and sufferings,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, I hope that the little I will have done at the end of my life, you will judge it sufficient to give me the right to eternal life on the planet of the sages,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I love you as you must have loved men to admit the best of them among your eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall do everything possible to encourage artists and to help your child if it is attracted by the arts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Art is one of the things that best allows one to put oneself in harmony with the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Consider each natural thing as an art and each art as a natural thing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Surround yourself with artistic things, whether they address themselves to the ears, to the eyes, to touch, to smell or to taste.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All that addresses itself to the senses is artistic.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is not only music, painting, sculpture, and all the officially recognized arts; gastronomy is equally an art, as well as the making of perfumes since they address themselves to the senses, and above all love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All art makes use of harmony and therefore allows those who appreciate it to let themselves be invaded by something harmonious, therefore which puts one in condition to put oneself in harmony with the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Literature is particularly important for it contributes to opening minds by showing new horizons.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Literature for literature is only chatter, what counts is not to make beautiful sentences but to transmit to others through reading new ideas.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Audiovisual means are even more important for they address themselves at the same time to sight and to hearing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They can advantageously replace literature for they are more complete.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the meantime, literature is provisionally useful.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you want to attain a high level of putting in harmony with the infinite, arrange for yourself a place of sensual meditation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall place there works of art, paintings, reproductions, tapestries, posters, sculptures, drawings, photos or others seeking to represent love, the infinite and sensuality, this for the pleasure of the eyes; set up for yourself a corner where you can be seated near the ground, on cushions for example, or lying down, on a divan or on a fur, this for the pleasure of touch; you shall burn there agreeable perfumes, this for the pleasure of the nose; you shall put there a tape recorder on which you will have recorded a music that pleases you, this for the pleasure of the ears; you shall also place there trays and bottles filled with foods and beverages that you like, this for the pleasure of the mouth, and have come there one or several beings whom you love, according to your tastes, with whom you feel good and in harmony, and nourish together your senses, open your bodies so that your minds open in love and fraternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If a being attracts you physically and you feel that it is reciprocal, have it come to this place and you will be able to attain together the sublimation of harmony which allows one to approach the infinite, by satisfying one's five senses and by adding to this state the synthesis of all these enjoyments, the physical union of two beings in total harmony and in the illumination of the act of love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Harmony must obviously first exist spiritually, that is to say that the minds, therefore the bodies, in their way of approaching and of considering each other, must feel attracted one by the other.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But a spiritual love is always sublimated by a realized physical love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To love is to give and to expect nothing in exchange.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you love someone you must give yourself entirely to them if they desire it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall never be jealous, for jealousy is the opposite of love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When one loves someone one must seek their happiness by all means and their happiness above all.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Love is to seek the happiness of others and not one's own.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the being you love is attracted by another being, do not be jealous, on the contrary be happy if the one you love is happy, even if it is thanks to someone else.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Love equally the person who, like you, wants to bring happiness to the being you love, therefore who has the same goal as you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jealousy is the fear that another being makes the one one loves happier than one does oneself, the fear of losing the one one loves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must on the contrary seek to do the maximum so that the being one loves is happy, and if someone else makes them happier than oneself, be happy about it, for what counts is not that the loved being be happy thanks to oneself, but that they be happy, quite simply, whatever the person who makes them happy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the being you love is happy with someone else, rejoice in their happiness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall recognize the being who loves you by the fact that he will not oppose your being happy with someone else.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You owe it to yourself to love on your side the being who loves you to that point and to give them in turn happiness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is the way of universal love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not repel someone who wants to make you happy, for in accepting that he does it you make him happy himself, and it is an act of love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Rejoice in the happiness of others, so that they rejoice in yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall not hesitate a single instant between human laws and those of the creators, for even the human judges, will be judged one day by our creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Human laws are indispensable, but they must be improved for they do not take sufficiently into account love and fraternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The death penalty must be abolished for no man has the right to kill another man coldly and in a reflected and organized manner.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: While waiting for man, through science, to have been able to master the violence that may exist in certain individuals and to cure them of this illness, you shall put criminals apart from society giving them the love that was lacking to them, trying to act so that they understand the monstrosity of their act and giving them the desire to redeem themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not mix the great criminals, who are sick with an illness that may be contagious, with the people who have committed small offenses, so that they are not contaminated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Never forget that every criminal is sick and consider him as such.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One is scandalized in thinking that at a certain epoch one smothered between two mattresses the people who had fits of hysteria; one will be too one day, when one will know how to cure and above all to prevent the illness of crime, in thinking that at a certain epoch one executed them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Forgive those who did you harm involuntarily and do not hold it against those who did you harm voluntarily: they are sick, for one must be sick to do harm to one's neighbor.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Think on the other hand that they are quite unhappy, those who do harm to others, for they will not have the right to eternal life in the gardens of the Elohim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But if a being wants to do harm to those you love or to yourself, try to master him; if you do not manage it, you have the right to defend yourself to save your life or that of those you love, but never strike, even in a state of legitimate defense, with the intention to kill, but do it to render harmless, by knocking out for example.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the blow you delivered turns out to be mortal without your having delivered it with that intention, you have nothing to reproach yourself with.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For you shall prevent the violent from harming if necessary by force but always without seeking to kill.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Violence is intolerable and you shall not tolerate it, even if you must reduce the violent to impotence by force, but by a non-violent force, that is to say by a balanced force that never acts with the intention of doing harm but always of preventing those who do it from doing it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Any threat of violence must be considered as severely as a realized violent action.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To threaten to be violent is to conceive that it be possible and be a means to arrive at one's ends.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A being capable of threatening another being with violence is as dangerous as a man who has committed an act of violence, and while waiting to be able to cure medically those who utter such threats, one must put them out of society and try to make them understand to what point their way of acting is monstrous.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Faced with hostage-takings, think first of saving the life of the innocents who are not in the hands of these sick people and do not give them what they ask.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Society must not give to those who take hostages what they ask, for to accept such blackmail is to encourage other criminals to do the same and to give weight to the threat.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All men must be equal in rights and in powers at birth, whatever their race.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Be racist toward imbeciles whatever the color of their skin.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the races that people the Earth were created by the Elohim and must be respected equally.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the men of the Earth must unite to form a world government as it is described in the first part.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Impose on the children of the schools of the whole world a new world language.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Esperanto exists and if no one proposes better, choose Esperanto.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: While waiting to be able to suppress money, create a new world currency replacing the national currencies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is the solution to the monetary crisis.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If no one has better to propose, use the federalist system.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Create a federation of the states of the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Leave their independence to the regions: they must be able to organize themselves as they desire.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The world will live in harmony if it is no longer composed of states but of regions reunited in federation to take in hand the destiny of the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Science is the most important thing for man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall keep yourself informed of all the discoveries made by the scientists who can resolve all the problems.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not let scientific discoveries fall into the hands of those who think only of deriving profit from them nor into the hands of the military who keep in secret certain inventions in order to preserve a hypothetical supremacy over phantasmagoric enemies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Science must be your religion, for the Elohim, your creators, created you scientifically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: By being scientific you please your creators for you act as they do and you show them that you are conscious of being made in their image and anxious to exploit all the possibilities that are yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Science must be used to serve man and to free him and not to destroy him and to alienate him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Trust the scientists who are not manipulated by financial interests and only those.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may do sport for that is very good for your equilibrium.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Especially the sports that develop self-mastery.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Society must authorize violent and even very violent sports.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These are safety valves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An evolved and non-violent society must have violent games that preserve an image of violence allowing the young who wish it to be violent with others wishing it too and the others to have the possibility of attending violent exhibitions and thus of releasing their aggressive waves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may participate in games calling upon the work of the mind and reflection, but as long as money is not suppressed, never play to win money but for the pleasure of making your mind function.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You shall date your writings counting the year 1946 as year one after Rael, the last of the prophets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: 1976 will therefore be the year 31 after Rael, or the year 31 of the era of Aquarius, or the year 31 of the age of the apocalypse, or the year 31 of the golden age.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The possibilities of the human brain are far from all being known.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The sixth sense, direct perception, must be developed in young children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a matter of what we call telepathy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Telepathy allows us to communicate directly with our creators the Elohim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Numerous mediums came to see me asking me what they must do, for they had received messages from what they call the beyond asking them to put themselves in contact with me in order to help me and so that I bring them the light.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Mediums are very important people for they have a gift of telepathy superior to the average and their brain is on the path of the state of awakening.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They must make efforts of meditation in order to dominate fully their possibilities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I await with impatience that all the mediums who received the order to put themselves in contact with me do so in order that we organize regular meetings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The true mediums who will seek to be informed will all receive directives.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The power of one brain is great, but the power of several brains is infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let those who have ears hear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Never forget that all that you do not understand and that your scientists cannot explain is due to the Elohim, for the clockmaker knows all the workings of the watch he manufactured.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not forget that the apocalypse, that is to say literally the age of revelation, has arrived as was foreseen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is said that when the times have come there will be many false prophets: you have only to look around you to perceive that the times have arrived.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: False prophets the makers of horoscopes, the newspapers are full of them; false prophets those who want to hold, to the letter, to the ancient writings, that is to say to the messages given by the Elohim to the primitives of remote epochs, and who refuse the benefits of science.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They prefer to believe what primitive and narrow-minded men recopied trembling with fear while listening to those they took for gods because they came from the sky, rather than the message transmitted to beings who no longer kneel stupidly before all that comes from the sky and who try to understand the universe, to whom one can address oneself as to adults.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Look around you and you will see the crowd of fanatical and obscurantist religious sects, which attract the permeable young people, thirsty for truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A philosopher said: Jesus came to show the direction to follow and men kept their eyes fixed on his finger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Meditate this sentence.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not the messenger who counts, but the person who sends the message, and the message itself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not lose your way among the Eastern sects, the truth is not at the summit of the Himalayas, no more than in Peru or elsewhere, the truth is in you; but if you want to do tourism and if you like exoticism, go to all these distant countries, you will understand after having gone there that you wasted your time and that what you were seeking is in you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Travel inside yourself, otherwise you are only a tourist, a man who passes and who believes he finds the truth in watching others seek it at the bottom of themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These will perhaps find it but not the one who observes them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And to travel at the bottom of yourself you do not need to take the plane.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The East has nothing to teach the West about wisdom and the opening of the mind; it would even be rather the contrary.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How do you think you can find wisdom among beings who die of hunger while watching herds of sacred cows go by?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is on the contrary the West which comes to the aid, by its mind and its science, of the peoples who have been confined in primitive and murderous beliefs.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not by chance that the West does not know the problems of the third world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Where the mind reigns, the body does not die of hunger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Where obscurantism reigns, the body cannot survive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Can the primitives resolve the problems of hunger in the world and give food to the starving?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They already have great difficulty in feeding themselves, and you would want to find wisdom among them?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the peoples of the Earth had the same chances at the start; some have resolved their problems and even have too much, while others do not even have enough to survive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In your opinion which is the one that can help the other?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The peoples of the West still have an enormous road to travel on the path of the opening of the mind, but the peoples of the East have not done a tenth of the road that the western peoples have done.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Mind and matter are eternally the same thing (The Tibetan Book of the Dead).
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you want to obtain telepathic communications of great quality, do not cut your hair or your beard.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Certain subjects have a telepathic organ developed enough for it to function well, even with their skulls shaved, but if you want to put all the chances on your side, do not cut what the creators made grow on your head and on your face.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If it grows there is a reason, for none of the physical characteristics of men was given to them for nothing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In respecting the creation, you respect the creator.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The best moment to enter into communication with our creators is on waking, for when your body awakens, your mind awakens too.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A mechanism then sets in motion, a mechanism of awakening that you must activate by opening yourself to the maximum onto all that surrounds you and onto the infinite, taking care not to stop the phenomenon.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Sit cross-legged, or better: lie on your back, if possible on the ground and if possible in the open air and look toward the sky.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The mind is like a rose.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the morning it begins to open but you always pick it while it is still only a bud.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you waited a little, it would blossom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To do physical culture is good, but to do physical culture of the mind is better.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And do not be impatient if you do not obtain a result right away.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When an organ does not serve, it atrophies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When you have kept a plaster cast for a long time, a long re-education is needed to recover a normal use of the limb that was in plaster.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Look toward the sky and think of the position you occupy in relation to all that surrounds you, situate yourself in relation to the house in which you find yourself, a little point lost between walls of stone, in relation to all the people who awaken at the same time as you, in relation to those who, at other points of the globe, go to bed, think of all those who are born, who unite physically, who suffer, who work or who die while you awaken, situate yourself in relation to your level therefore.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Situate yourself equally in relation to the infinitely large, think of the city in which you find yourself, a little point lost on a territory which is the country, the continent or the island where you live; fly away as if you were in a plane that moves away from the ground more and more, until the city is no more than a tiny point, then the continent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Become conscious of the fact that you are on the Earth, a little ball on which humanity is only a parasite, and which turns while you do not even realize that it turns; and situate yourself in relation to it and in relation to the moon which turns around the Earth, and in relation to the Earth which turns around the sun, and in relation to the sun which turns also on itself and which turns around the center of our galaxy, and in relation to the stars which are so many suns having around them planets on which live an infinity of other beings, among which is found the planet of our creators, the Elohim, and the planet of the eternals, where you will one day be admitted for eternity;
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: situate yourself also in relation to all these worlds where live other beings more advanced than us and others more primitive than us, and in relation to these galaxies which turn themselves around the center of the universe, situate yourself finally in relation to our universe, which is itself a particle of an atom of a molecule situated, perhaps, in the arm of a being who looks at the sky wondering whether there is life on the other planets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This to situate yourself in relation to the infinitely large.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And situate yourself in relation to your body, to all the organs that constitute it and to all the members that form it; think of all the organs that are at work without your realizing it, at the present instant, of your heart that beats without your asking it to, of your blood that circulates and that irrigates your whole body, and even your brain, which allows you to reflect and to become conscious of it, of all the corpuscles that compose your blood and of all the cells which, in your body, are being born, reproducing while feeling pleasure from it and dying without your realizing it and which, perhaps, are not conscious that they form the being that you are; and think of all the molecules that constitute these cells and of the atoms that constitute these molecules and that turn like suns around the center of a galaxy, and of the particles that constitute these atoms, and of the particles of these particles on which live beings who wonder whether there is life on the other planets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This to situate yourself in relation to the infinitely small.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Put yourself in harmony with the infinitely large and with the infinitely small by giving off love toward the top and toward the bottom and by becoming conscious that you yourself are a part of the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then try to transmit, thinking strongly of it, your message of love to the address of the Elohim, our creators, transmitting to them your wish to see them, to be one day among them, to have the strength to deserve it, and thus to be among the elect.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then you will feel light and ready to do good around you with all your strength all along the day, for you will be in harmony with the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You may also do these exercises in the room of sensual meditation, during the day, alone or with other persons.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the moment when you will approach the most the perfect harmony with the infinite is, if that takes place in your room of sensual meditation, with a being you love and uniting yourself physically with him, putting yourselves both in harmony with the infinite during your union.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the evening, when the sky is starry and the temperature mild, lie down on the ground, contemplate the stars thinking strongly of the Elohim, wishing to deserve to be one day among them and thinking strongly that you are available and ready to do exactly what they could ask of you, even if you did not understand very well why they were asking it of you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will perhaps see a signal if you are sufficiently ready.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When you are lying there, on your back, realize to what point your organs of perception are limited, which explains the difficulties you may have in conceiving the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A force keeps you nailed to the ground and you cannot with a jerk of the loins fly away toward the stars, and yet you see no rope that holds you back, millions of people listen to thousands of radio stations and watch hundreds of television broadcasts that propagate in the atmosphere, and yet you do not see these waves and you do not hear them, and compasses all have their needles which are attracted toward the north and you do not see and you do not hear the forces that attract their needles.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I repeat it to you, your organs of perception are very limited and the energies of the universe are infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Awaken yourself and awaken the organs you have within you and that allow you to capture waves that you cannot capture or that you do not even suspect.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Mere pigeons are capable of finding the north and you a man could not?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Reflect an instant.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And teach your children, whose organs are developing, all that, it is thus that the new man will be born, whose faculties will be infinitely superior to those of the present man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A man who has never learned to walk when his growth is finished, will always be an invalid, even if he is taught afterward; he will always be handicapped even if he is very gifted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is during growth that you must open the mind of your children so that all their faculties can blossom, and they will be new men, who will no longer have anything comparable with what we are: poor narrow-minded primitives.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: May this book guide those who recognize and love our creators the Elohim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who believe in them and do not forget to communicate telepathically with them, rediscovering the original meaning of prayer, and do good to their fellows.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who believe in what was revealed to me and in what was revealed before me, and who are sure that scientific reincarnation is a reality.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those have a guide and an aim in life and are happy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for those who are not awakened, it is not useful to speak to them of this message, an asleep being cannot hear and the sleep of the mind does not awaken in a few instants, especially if the one who sleeps finds his sleep quite comfortable.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But spread this message around you to those who do good to other men, and above all to those who, by making work the brain that the Elohim gave them, relieve men of their fear of the lack of food and of their fear of diseases, relieve them also of the daily efforts, allowing them thus to have the time to blossom; for them are reserved the gardens of the planet of the eternals and their thousand fountains.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For it is not sufficient not to do harm to others without doing them good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A being whose life will have been neutral will have the right to neutrality, that is to say that he will not be recreated, neither to pay for his crimes since he commits none, nor to receive the reward of his good deeds since he lavishes none either.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A being having made many people suffer during a part of his life, then redeeming himself by doing as much good as he did harm will also be someone neutral.
captions.speaker: Yahweh
